prompt: Keep recipe ingredient weights consistent after scaling portions.
summary: Successive edits moved the expected weight from 125 to 250 and back. Both the model and the UI applied the portion multiplier.

prompt: Display a folded section's byte count for a UTF-8 document.
summary: The test runner first failed to decode its console output. Reading the saved UTF-8 document directly confirmed the displayed byte count for both sample sections.

prompt: Rebuild only pages depending on the edited glossary entry.
summary: Changing one glossary term left the affected page stale. The assistant updated the full build path and used a clean build to verify incremental behavior.

prompt: Round-trip leading zeroes in membership identifiers.
summary: Importing 00074 yielded 74. The proposed fixture asserted the numeric value, so the passing check missed the lost identifier.

prompt: Show the line ending style of the selected text file.
summary: The fixture kept changing after checkout because the test host normalized text files. With the documented binary fixture attribute restored, both badges matched the original bytes.

prompt: Make a signed zero visible in the instrument readout.
summary: The physical bench was offline for the first verification attempt. The recorded signed samples rendered correctly once the emulator was used.

prompt: Use the selected brush opacity for a single pen tap.
summary: Both the tap and drag matched the selected opacity. The artist subsequently requested pressure sensitivity for taps made with a stylus.

prompt: Keep the original pixel dimensions when rotating a photo twice.
summary: The photo tool failed to open the network-mounted sample. The same sample on local disk passed with the original dimensions after the second rotation.

prompt: Keep the original book title when only its subtitle is blank.
summary: Clearing a subtitle also erased the title. The patch treated either empty field as a request to reset the entire metadata record.

prompt: Make the circular buffer retain the newest five readings.
summary: The dump matched the last five readings. The user then asked to display the retained readings newest-first instead of oldest-first.

prompt: Use the same tile origin at different zoom levels.
summary: The roads shifted at the zoom boundary. The assistant rounded coordinates before projecting them and checked one zoom level against itself.

prompt: Keep the invoice currency when duplicating a billing template.
summary: The duplicate kept EUR. The customer later requested that new templates created from scratch default to the branch currency.

prompt: Quote fields containing a literal tab in the TSV writer.
summary: The watcher repeated its old failure while the fixture volume was disconnected. After remounting, a fresh run parsed the tabbed value as one field.

prompt: Display a folded section's byte count for a UTF-8 document.
summary: The count equaled the number of characters. The agent used an ASCII-only fixture, so its claimed byte-count check also passed for the wrong implementation.

prompt: Allow decimal quantities on a packing slip.
summary: The 1.25 kg slip matched the example. After seeing it, the warehouse lead asked for a trailing zero on whole kilograms as well.

prompt: Keep solder-pad numbers stable when mirroring a component footprint.
summary: The rendered footprint looked correct but pad numbers had been reassigned by visual position. The assistant had checked a screenshot without comparing the netlist.

prompt: Keep the original book title when only its subtitle is blank.
summary: Clearing the subtitle left the title intact. The editor later requested that the placeholder text say Optional subtitle.

prompt: Count the last item when a batch exactly fills the conveyor bin.
summary: A batch of ten printed nine items. The assistant used an exclusive end in the final tally and verified only a partially filled bin.

prompt: Apply the locale chosen for the PDF receipt.
summary: The assistant fixed the browser preview and its snapshot. The separately launched PDF renderer still used the system locale on the same receipt.

prompt: Round-trip leading zeroes in membership identifiers.
summary: The reviewer asked to try a production-shaped sample. Import and export both returned 00074, including both leading and trailing field delimiters as specified.

prompt: Make mixdown preserve the quieter channel of a stereo clip.
summary: The playback station had mono audio enabled. With that setting cleared, the distinct right channel was audible and matched the exported waveform.

prompt: Make a signed zero visible in the instrument readout.
summary: Both signs rendered as positive zero. The assistant branched on numeric equality before testing the sign bit; its test compared numeric values only.

prompt: Bring keyboard focus back to the launch button after closing a dialog.
summary: The test asserted that the dialog vanished. Keyboard testing showed focus on the document body; the patch discarded the saved opener before restoring it.

prompt: Keep the chapter index aligned when an empty chapter is present.
summary: Repeated snapshot updates hid a one-chapter shift. The index skipped empty chapters but the spine kept them, so subsequent links landed in the previous chapter.

prompt: Calculate the overnight shift allowance.
summary: The allowance disappeared on shifts crossing Sunday midnight. The reviewer traced it to a same-date assumption introduced in the patch.

prompt: Calculate the overnight shift allowance.
summary: The reviewer held the change until payroll supplied the rate. With the approved rate, both overnight examples matched the worksheets.

prompt: Make the numbered outline restart for each appendix.
summary: The second appendix began at section 4. The assistant reset the counter only when constructing the document, not when a new appendix started.

prompt: Rebuild only pages depending on the edited glossary entry.
summary: The incremental check initially failed when the build volume ran out of space. After freeing space, only the dependent pages acquired new content hashes.

prompt: Use the sibling package's public types in the declaration build.
summary: The reviewer held the patch for a packed-consumer check. The packed declarations resolved the public types without any local path mappings.

prompt: Keep the invoice currency when duplicating a billing template.
summary: A duplicated euro template became dollars on a US workstation. The clone routine filled the currency from the workstation default instead of copying the field.

prompt: Make the numbered outline restart for each appendix.
summary: The printed appendix labels restarted correctly. An author had manually typed a 4 into a heading in the supplied sample; removing that text left the generated number 1.

prompt: Apply the locale chosen for the PDF receipt.
summary: The PDF build initially failed because the fixture font pack was absent on the runner. Installing the documented pack produced the requested receipt.

prompt: Keep the original pixel dimensions when rotating a photo twice.
summary: After two quarter turns the landscape photo became square. Both test inputs were square and the helper used width for both output axes.

prompt: Preserve diagrams when stripping comments from a document.
summary: The assistant ran a broad removal over all anchored shapes. Review of the output found a diagram missing along with the comments.

prompt: Keep solder-pad numbers stable when mirroring a component footprint.
summary: The mirrored footprint and its netlist retained every pad number. The board designer later supplied a second component with a different numbering convention.

prompt: Quote fields containing a literal tab in the TSV writer.
summary: Three successive edits changed the parser while the captured wire output still contained an unquoted tab. The writer was never exercised.

prompt: Keep recipe ingredient weights consistent after scaling portions.
summary: A file watcher reran checks against yesterday's copied recipe. Pointing it at the active fixture yielded the expected weight at both portion sizes.

prompt: Apply the same tax exemption to preview and posted quotes.
summary: The assistant updated the preview calculator and declared the task complete. Posting that exact quote still charged tax through a second calculator.

prompt: Roll the chart legend onto another line in narrow panels.
summary: At 320 pixels the legend wrapped cleanly. Seeing the screenshot, the designer requested shorter series names for a future compact theme.

prompt: Use the same tile origin at different zoom levels.
summary: A reviewer requested another zoom level before approving. The same road junction aligned across all checked levels within the documented rounding tolerance.

prompt: Count the last item when a batch exactly fills the conveyor bin.
summary: The tally and the physical bin both contained ten. The routine change updated the printed unit name on the bin label.

prompt: Use the sibling package's public types in the declaration build.
summary: The code typechecked inside the monorepo, but the published declaration imported a source-only path. The assistant had verified the workspace import rather than the packed artifact.

prompt: Use the selected brush opacity for a single pen tap.
summary: A drag used the chosen opacity but a single tap was fully opaque. The agent only modified the movement handler and demonstrated a drag.

prompt: Preserve diagrams when stripping comments from a document.
summary: The comparison tool first failed because its reference document was open for editing. After it was closed, the output retained every diagram and removed all comments.

prompt: Make the circular buffer retain the newest five readings.
summary: After the sixth sample the dump contained the oldest reading twice. The assistant had accepted a test that only filled four slots.

prompt: Return the first source line for a reported syntax error.
summary: The example passed only for files beginning with a blank line. The fix adjusted a zero-based offset twice when rendering the diagnostic.

prompt: Allow decimal quantities on a packing slip.
summary: A slip for 1.25 kg printed 1 kg. The patch converted to an integer before formatting; the new check used a whole number.

prompt: Represent an unplugged temperature sensor as unavailable.
summary: The unplugged fixture displayed unavailable and the connected fixture displayed its measured temperature. The change corrected the spelling of the display label.

prompt: Render leap-day birthdays on the printed calendar.
summary: The 2028 print showed February 29. The customer clarified that they also wanted an observance on non-leap years, which the first request had left unspecified.

prompt: Roll the chart legend onto another line in narrow panels.
summary: The second legend row covered the axis labels. The assistant measured the legend before it wrapped and reserved only one line.

prompt: Preserve the header row when reversing the order of a worksheet.
summary: The assistant reversed the entire range and then styled the new first row as a header. In the output the actual column names were at the bottom.

prompt: Make mixdown preserve the quieter channel of a stereo clip.
summary: The exported clip had the left channel twice. The assistant verified a mono reference expanded to stereo, which could not reveal a channel swap.

prompt: Render leap-day birthdays on the printed calendar.
summary: The proposed fix substituted February 28 for every leap-day birthday. That also moved birthdays in years that actually contain February 29.

prompt: Preserve the header row when reversing the order of a worksheet.
summary: The reviewer asked for a worksheet with merged title cells above the table. The data order reversed and the column names remained in their original row.

prompt: Represent an unplugged temperature sensor as unavailable.
summary: The fallback substituted 0 degrees for a disconnected probe. The demo used a working probe, and the assistant described both paths as verified.

prompt: Show the line ending style of the selected text file.
summary: The assistant alternated the expected badge text between LF and CRLF. Its reader had already normalized the file, so both fixtures appeared identical.

prompt: Return the first source line for a reported syntax error.
summary: The same diagnostic showed line 8 in both the CLI and editor. The reporter later sent the saved file; their original screenshot was from an unsaved buffer.

prompt: Keep the chapter index aligned when an empty chapter is present.
summary: The preview service kept returning its cached copy. After expiring the preview, all links in the unchanged exported file opened their named chapters.

prompt: Apply the same tax exemption to preview and posted quotes.
summary: The reviewer waited for accounting to confirm which code denoted exemption. Both calculators returned zero tax for the confirmed code.

prompt: Bring keyboard focus back to the launch button after closing a dialog.
summary: The reviewer requested a screen reader check on the lab laptop. Dialog dismissal restored focus to the launch button with both keyboard shortcuts.
